judged_text: The dedup/blacklist filter compares emails case-sensitively (guest === attendee.email and blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)) while the blacklist is lowercased and guest input is never normalized. adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed with case-sensitive checks: `guest === attendee.email` and `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`. However, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is explicitly lowercased (`map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`) while `guest` is never normalized (neither in the handler nor in the Zod schema/UI). This makes it verifiable from the diff that `User@Example.com` can bypass both the existing-attendee dedup check and the blacklist check when the stored/blacklisted value is `user@example.com`, potentially creating duplicate attendee records/emails/ICS updates.
